column1: # The Bitwarden shield glyphs each reviewed icon font holds (review round 46 PR-MED-033): <sha256> TAB <path in the
# package> TAB <code point>[,<code point>…]. check-artefacts.mjs forbids these code points in every script, page and
# stylesheet (outside the glyph's own CSS definition) whenever a package carries that font — whatever the stylesheet
# says, so removing or renaming a selector cannot switch the rule off. Every `bwi-font` file a package carries must have
# a row here (a new font fails until someone reads its glyph map: the SVG form names each glyph, `glyph-name=` /
# `unicode=`). The four formats of upstream's browser-v2026.10.2 font, read from its SVG form 2026-11-12:
# `<glyph glyph-name="bitwarden-shield" unicode="">`; `.bwi-shield` and `.bwi-bitwarden-shield` both draw it.
